description:
User approved 2026-11-24 for the end of the fz-9x7 epic (relayed by GC).

Heap::publish_entries_in_place (runtime/src/heap/imp.rs:822) decodes each entry into an AnyValue only to call .raw()/.kind(). Read them instead with map_locate + map_slot_raw_kinds (any_value/map_node.rs:258) and pass the four values to publish_contained_parts.

Evidence: on PR #852 (fz-9x7.11.2), LLVM compiled the unchanged map_slot's kind match with 4 compares instead of 2. That took it from 65 to 70 instructions per call, at 2 calls per map, and gave gc-maps-short +1.04% instructions, which the user waived.

Expected: at least 10 fewer instructions per map built. Not yet measured; judged on bench.
title: A map build reads its entries' words and kinds directly
